description: Build the admin frontend: a new dependency-free vanilla-JS admin page (frontend/admin.html + frontend/admin.js) reachable at the admin URL /admin.html. It authenticates the admin via Cognito Hosted UI (OAuth redirect), obtains an id_token JWT, and lets the admin create a custom quiz (title + N questions with options + correct answer) by calling the authenticated POST /api/admin/quizzes with an Authorization: Bearer <id_token> header. Depends on FEAT-002 (the write API + Cognito) existing.
steps: Create frontend/admin.html: same structure/lang='ja' and styles.css link as index.html. Sections: (1) a login prompt with a 'ログイン' button when not authenticated; (2) an admin form when authenticated: a title input, a dynamic list of questions where each question has a text input, 2-4 option inputs, and a radio to mark the correct option, plus '問題を追加' and '登録する' buttons; (3) a status/result area. Include a 'ログアウト' button. Load config.js then admin.js.

Create frontend/admin.js (vanilla JS, no framework, no build). Read Cognito config from window: window.COGNITO_DOMAIN (Hosted UI base URL), window.COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, and window.API_BASE (reuse config.js). Implement the OAuth flow: on 'ログイン' click, redirect to `${COGNITO_DOMAIN}/login?client_id=${COGNITO_CLIENT_ID}&response_type=token&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${encodeURIComponent(currentAdminUrl)}` (implicit grant returns tokens in the URL fragment; simplest for a static SPA with no backend token exchange). On page load, parse window.location.hash for id_token/access_token/expires_in; if present, store id_token in memory (and optionally sessionStorage) and strip the hash from the URL via history.replaceState.

Gate the admin form on presence of a non-expired id_token; if absent, show the login prompt only. 'ログアウト' clears the token and redirects to `${COGNITO_DOMAIN}/logout?client_id=${COGNITO_CLIENT_ID}&logout_uri=${encodeURIComponent(currentAdminUrl)}`.

Implement the quiz-creation form: dynamic add/remove of question blocks; each question collects text, options (2-4), and which option is correct (radio -> answerIndex). On submit, build the payload { title, questions:[{text, options, answerIndex}], quizId? } and POST to `${API_BASE}/admin/quizzes` with headers { 'content-type':'application/json', authorization: 'Bearer '+idToken }. Reuse a fetchJson-style helper (can mirror app.js) that checks res.ok, surfaces 401/403 as a clear 'ログインが必要です / 権限がありません' message, and parses JSON. On 201, show the returned quizId + questionCount and offer a link back to the quiz app.

Do client-side validation mirroring the server rules (non-empty title, each question has text + >=2 non-empty options + a selected correct answer) so the admin gets fast feedback, but rely on the server as the source of truth.

Update config.js: add placeholders window.COGNITO_DOMAIN='' and window.COGNITO_CLIENT_ID='' with comments explaining these come from the CDK CfnOutputs (Hosted UI domain + UserPoolClientId) and, under Amplify Hosting, are injected at build time from Amplify environment variables (see FEAT-004). Keep window.API_BASE too.
Add minimal admin-specific styling to styles.css (e.g. .admin-question block, small inputs) OR reuse existing classes; keep it lightweight. Do not introduce a CSS framework.

Add a small '管理者ページ' link from index.html to admin.html (optional but helpful) OR document the /admin.html URL in the README (done in FEAT-005... note README is folded into FEAT-004). Keep the public quiz flow unchanged.
Run `node --check frontend/admin.js` in-sandbox to confirm the plain JS parses.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/admin.html and frontend/admin.js exist and are dependency-free vanilla JS/HTML consistent with the existing SPA style.
The admin page performs a Cognito Hosted UI OAuth redirect login, captures the id_token from the redirect, and hides the creation form until authenticated.
Submitting the form POSTs to `${API_BASE}/admin/quizzes` with an Authorization: Bearer <id_token> header and a correctly-shaped { title, questions:[{text,options,answerIndex}] } payload.
401/403 responses produce a clear Japanese 'authentication/permission required' message rather than a crash.
`node --check frontend/admin.js` passes and config.js exposes COGNITO_DOMAIN, COGNITO_CLIENT_ID, and API_BASE placeholders.
verification: Read admin.js and confirm: the login redirect URL is built from COGNITO_DOMAIN/COGNITO_CLIENT_ID; the id_token is read from the URL fragment and the fragment is cleared; the POST includes the Bearer header and the correct payload shape matching validateAndNormalizeQuizInput.
On the user's machine after deploy: log in via Hosted UI as a bootstrapped admin user, create a quiz, and confirm it appears in GET /api/quizzes (manual acceptance).
findings: Created frontend/admin.html + frontend/admin.js (dependency-free vanilla JS, matching app.js style: 'use strict', var, addEventListener). Cognito Hosted UI implicit-grant flow: login redirects to ${COGNITO_DOMAIN}/login?response_type=token&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=<admin.html>; id_token/expires_in parsed from window.location.hash, kept in memory + sessionStorage, hash stripped via history.replaceState; expiry tracked with 60s margin. Form gated on valid token. POST ${API_BASE}/admin/quizzes with Authorization: Bearer <id_token>; payload {title, questions:[{text, options, answerIndex}], quizId?}. answerIndex is recomputed against the non-empty options array so blank option rows don't shift the correct-answer index. postJson helper mirrors app.js fetchJson content-type guard and maps 401 -> 'ログインが必要です（認証エラー）' (also clears token) and 403 -> '権限がありません', otherwise surfaces server {message}. Client-side validation mirrors server rules (non-empty title, >=2 non-empty options, selected answer, quizId /^[a-z0-9-]+$/). Added window.COGNITO_DOMAIN='' and window.COGNITO_CLIENT_ID='' placeholders to config.js with CfnOutput/Amplify comments (kept API_BASE). Added admin styles to styles.css and a '管理者ページ' link in index.html (public flow unchanged). Verified with `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --check` on admin.js/config.js/app.js (all pass). Did NOT touch CDK stack, lambda/, or tests (FEAT-004 scope). npm/tsc/jest not runnable in-sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY), but this feature is frontend-only with no build step.
